## LmdbJobRunScheduleOptions.task property

The work to run on each tick.

**Signature:**

```typescript
task: () => Promise<unknown>;
```

## Remarks

A rejection is routed to `onError` and never stops the schedule. The run stamp is written only after this resolves, so a thrown error leaves the job overdue and the next boot retries it.
